narrative: A leaf of the comedy on the table by the cheese. Her pen lies in the margin. Two words are struck in his hand and rewritten above in a smaller hand. No face. The same leaf, a corner turned where a thumb held it. Nothing else on the page is touched. The leaf stays when the hand leaves. The pen stays. A rind of cheese is at the edge.

entities.name: Jacqueline Field
entities.context: Her pen and her two corrections were on the leaf.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the strokes, and left them.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Shown on draft in Her pen on the leaf
